content.question: What does Gini impurity estimate?
options: The probability of misclassification when randomly choosing an element from the node and labeling it; it is defined as 1 − Σ p(i)².
The uncertainty of the data, computed as the negative sum of p(i) · log₂ p(i).
The reduction of impurity achieved by a split.
The average depth of the tree.
content.answer: The probability of misclassification when randomly choosing an element from the node and labeling it; it is defined as 1 − Σ p(i)².
